name: Appwrite
description: Provides an open-source backend with auth, databases, storage, functions, hosting, and messaging for app developers, via REST APIs, SDKs, a CLI, and a hosted MCP server.

skills.name: MCP Project Tools
skills.description: Searches and calls the Appwrite tool catalog at runtime through appwrite_search_tools and appwrite_call_tool to manage project resources.

skills.name: Documentation Search
skills.description: Semantically searches Appwrite documentation through the appwrite_search_docs MCP tool for current SDK, API, and CLI guidance.

skills.name: Realtime Subscriptions
skills.description: Subscribes to channels over a WebSocket and receives database, storage, and account events within milliseconds as they change.

skills.name: Event Webhooks
skills.description: Sends signed HTTP POST payloads to a configured URL when selected project events fire, managed from the Console or a Server SDK.
